title: /harness/branch/[branch]/[...at]/layouts
responsibility: Shows the layouts of this repository at a branch tip or a selected commit, to search, order and open.

outputs.name: +page
outputs.description: The route renders HarnessScreen with the fixed title Layouts and ExplorerCatalogScreen as its content component. This file declares no route inputs or layout data, so catalog contents and behavior come from the imported components.

outputs.name: title
outputs.description: This is the title string passed to HarnessScreen whenever the route renders. It is fixed here as Layouts and does not depend on the branch or commit.
